map.保护带收窄合格判定限，降低错判风险。: A guard band narrows the conformance limits and lowers the risk of wrong decisions.
Acceptance limit = specification limit ± U (or k*U depending on risk). Example: upper limit 10.00, U=0.02, accept at 9.98 to reduce false acceptance.
map.GB=1.65×0.12=0.1980。合格判定时把规范限向内缩 0.198，可: GB = 1.65 x 0.12 = 0.1980. Pulling the specification limit inward by 0.198 when judging conformance cuts false-acceptance risk to about 5%, at the cost of slightly more false rejects.
map.留不确定度余量，减小把超差判为合格（误收）。: It leaves an uncertainty margin and reduces the chance of passing an out-of-tolerance item (false acceptance).
map.过严增误废率，按风险平衡取舍。: Too tight a band raises the false-reject rate, so trade the two risks off against each other.
